catalog.container_strategy: Copy immutable source to a fresh dev build tree; compile and install QBE plus its IL documentation and tests. Target receives generated programs only.

native_probe.scope: This native dev build only; not a container size prediction or transient peak measurement.

catalog.purpose: A small complete SSA backend for real pass implementation, assembly inspection, differential testing and rapid native optimization experiments; not a replacement for industrial compiler qualification.
qualification_gaps: The selected installation recipe and physical target remain unqualified until their own receipts exist.
QBE IR, pass pipeline and debugging flags differ from LLVM; LLVM NewPM/Alive2 tools cannot directly validate QBE IR.
catalog.size_basis: Complete HTTPS payload measured locally; source logical bytes sum regular archive members, excluding allocation, build trees and external dependencies.
catalog.title: QBE compact optimizing compiler backend

examples.command: '{prefix}/bin/qbe' -t amd64_sysv -o program.s program.ssa && cc program.s -o program && ./program
examples.description: Compile native SSA through the system C linker.
Compile and execute a known program; require malformed SSA to be rejected.
Run the unchanged upstream test runner logic with its single fixed temporary-file prefix isolated for this invocation.

locations.label: QBE backend
locations.purpose: Translate QBE SSA to assembly; select an explicit backend with -t.

locations.label: IL documentation and tests
locations.purpose: Unmodified upstream doc, test and LICENSE directories retained at the original paths.

locations.label: Complete release source
locations.purpose: All locked release files; no dependency on the build directory.

locations.label: Installed functional checks
locations.purpose: Repeat compilation/rejection or upstream-test checks without the package state directory.

notes: Native Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 qualification covers the amd64_sysv backend. Included arm64/rv64/Apple/Windows backends are not claimed as executed.

The original selector deployment remains in metadata.catalog. Canonical checks use the original bin/qbe and share/qbe/test paths, so a legacy source installation does not need the new optional installed helper/source copy.

The installed source and check helper are additional package-profile files. The recipe copies the official runner and changes only tmp=/tmp/qbe.zzzz in a temporary copy to avoid collisions; it does not alter test cases or expected outputs.
No performance or official Benchmark score is inferred from these compiler functionality checks.
